interface.longDescription: Three local workflows: source-to-edition production, launch packets and creator operations. Includes evidence and revision checks, editable drafts, multi-brand job planning, supplied subscription audits and inventory-aware stack decisions with prepared workflow bindings. Optional remote MCP uses the existing GenCreator public endpoint; verify its tool list. Managed workspace access requires OAuth/readiness. This plugin does not start agents or publish. Creative Lab adds verified reference commissioning, three rendered directions, bounded workflow experiments, actual-build stories and independent evidence-linked learning.
